peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 10.5% above its local comparables; 41 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (49.0): 4.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 25 of 51 similar developments. Initial resale-wave effect: 15 of the 38 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jun 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,984,444 ($2,474 psf, 785–828 sq ft; 8 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,237 psf (range $1,973–2,434); 10.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $190,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,900,000 ($2,483 psf, 1,044–1,227 sq ft; 11 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,251 psf (range $2,035–2,991); 10.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $271,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 4.6 resales per 100 homes a year over 15 months (Jul 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 23 of 50 similar developments. First resale wave from Jul 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 4 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 4.8.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 60 m, Tiong Bahru MRT about 1,190 m; closer than 49 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Gan Eng Seng Primary School about 530 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 380 m), more than 15 of 51 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Redhill Market about 280 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 640 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,150 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,530 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,710 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,780 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,790 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,830 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,860 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 140 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,715 new sales and 804 resales (2,519 purchases); new sales were 68.1% of these purchases. Subsales (8) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 804 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 36 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 804 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 971 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.2%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
